frozen_note: Pre-registered at plan approval (2026-11-11). Any change after the first real query is logged as a deviation in the run manifest.
headline_population: real hypotheses only; controls feed P1-P3 and never enter headline metrics or decision-rule precision inputs

current.description: as deployed: Arm 1 openalex + exa + pubmed + s2

a_fix_query.description: current with PubMed Arm 2 Boolean (direct client) in place of Arm 1 PubMed

c_reweight.description: current sources, score = 1 - rank/fetch_limit per source; ties broken by SOURCE_PRIORITY

judge.missing_verdict: not_run; any not_run blocks verdicts, not diagnostics

audit.allocation: round-robin over strata sorted by (source, judge_hit), seeded shuffle within each stratum

certification.on_failure: no verdicts; diagnostics marked uncertified plus ID-matched landmark recall

pubmed_client_failure.description: the verified direct client returns >=1 paper on the identical Arm 1 sentence where the production client returns 0

fix_query.requires: Arm 2 precision > Arm 1 precision with paired bootstrap 95% CI over hypotheses excluding 0, AND Arm 2 precision >= 0.2

reweight.requires: mix c raises kept-set precision vs current, paired bootstrap CI excluding 0

judge_filter.requires: raises kept-set precision AND lowers false-support count, each with CI excluding 0

requires_all: zero judged hits in every kept set across all mixes
Wilson 95% upper bound on pooled per-source precision < 0.2

rules.keep: any difference whose interval includes 0 maps to keep-as-is
rules.unavailable: a source that did not run appears as unavailable with its reason

low.description: precision < low_precision_max counts as 'low' in the PubMed three-way diagnosis

kg: measured; excluded from drop and reweight verdicts (kept on product grounds)
